items.text: The big bitter lesson question in the applied AI layer is that as models get better and better, what is the best way to diffuse that intelligence into an enterprise. Ironically, I’d argue that as models are getting more capable, and can handle longer running tasks and better tool use, the ability to differentiate on a domain by domain basis goes up instead of down. When models were quite limited in what they could do, ironically all you could be literally was a “wrapper” because you were effectively delivering tokens back to the user with a custom prompt or some limited RAG. items.title: "O Infallible one, why do the people not heed the sign we tap
items.text: "O Infallible one, why do the people not heed the sign we tap?" "My dear Parth, each believes he is the first to wish for an end to chat. On X we are cursed with the eternal September of the Thoughtless Mind." "But O Govinda, they yearn for what lies beyond it, and cast their votes by the thousands. Surely the people's wants must be made." *a wan smile* “O son of Kunti, observe what they applaud, and what they return to. They desire the end of chat as they desire the end of desire. They desire to leave X as they return in ever greater numbers. They will announce it many times. You shall learn, as they do not, that the chief desire of the people of X is not the truth, but the new.”
